description: A student takes calcium pills and vitamin D pills one after the other. Each calcium pill takes 5 minutes to be effective while each vitamin D pill takes 6 minutes to be effective. Over a month, the student must take at least 130 pills of medication and at least 40 should be vitamin D pills because they enhance the absorption of calcium in the body. Since vitamin D is complimentary to calcium, the student must take more calcium pills than vitamin D pills. How many pills of each should the student take to minimize the total time it takes for the medication to be effective?

TimeToEffectCalcium.definition: Time it takes for a calcium pill to be effective

TimeToEffectVitaminD.definition: Time it takes for a vitamin D pill to be effective

MinTotalPills.definition: Minimum total number of pills to be taken in a month

MinVitaminDPills.definition: Minimum number of vitamin D pills to be taken in a month

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required for all the calcium and vitamin D pills taken over the month to become effective"

constraints.description: The total number of pills taken must be at least 130
The number of vitamin D pills taken must be at least 40
The number of calcium pills taken must be greater than the number of vitamin D pills taken
The numbers of calcium pills and vitamin D pills taken must be integers

CalciumPills.definition: Number of calcium pills taken in a month

VitaminDPills.definition: Number of vitamin D pills taken in a month
